title: KFSHRC to Partake Tomorrow as Strategic Partner in C3 Davos of Healthcare™ New York Summit
summary: NEW YORK, Sept. 07, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — King Faisal Specialist Hospital & Research Centre (KFSHRC) will participate tomorrow (Monday) as a Strategic Partner in the C3 Davos of Healthcare™ New York Summit, “Healthcare Disrupted: The Future of AI, Data & Precision Medicine,” taking place at the Union League Club in New York City.
